prompt.en: Give each star its colour back.

hint1.en: Try two kinds of stardust together, and watch the star.
hint1.ar: جَرِّبْ نَوْعَيْنِ مِنْ غُبَارِ النُّجُومِ مَعًا، وَرَاقِبِ النَّجْمَة.

hint2.en: One of the right ones is glowing. What goes with it?
hint2.ar: وَاحِدٌ مِنَ الصَّحِيحَيْنِ يَتَوَهَّج. مَاذَا يُنَاسِبُه؟

model.en: These two, together. Tap them, then the light.

success.en: Three stars, three colours back, and three things they saw.
success.ar: ثَلَاثُ نُجُومٍ عَادَتْ أَلْوَانُهَا، وَثَلَاثَةُ أَشْيَاءَ رَأَتْهَا.

payload._comment: The stars the page passed over went grey and cold. Each one relit says one thing it saw up close — and those three things are the three clues the climax is solved with. So this is not a colour lesson with a star on it: every colour made is a witness woken up.
payload._mixComment: Paint mixing, not light mixing, because it is what a four-year-old can check against their own hands; the stars' colour is stardust, so the story never claims otherwise. The table is complete — all seven combinations say what they make, including all three at once — because a child experimenting WILL try everything, and three-into-mud is itself worth discovering.
payload._orderComment: Orange first: red and yellow are the most familiar pair. Every round needs two, so no round can be answered by the dust that looks most like the target.

label.en: This star was orange. Make orange, then press the light.
label.ar: كَانَتْ هَذِهِ النَّجْمَةُ بُرْتُقَالِيَّة. اِصْنَعِ البُرْتُقَالِيّ، ثُمَّ اضْغَطِ الضَّوْء.

revealLine.en: It glows again, and whispers: it went by far above the clouds.
revealLine.ar: تَتَوَهَّجُ مِنْ جَدِيد، وَتَهْمِس: مَرَّ بَعِيدًا فَوْقَ الغُيُوم.

label.en: This one was green. There is no green dust. Can you make it?
label.ar: هَذِهِ كَانَتْ خَضْرَاء. لَا يُوجَدُ غُبَارٌ أَخْضَر. هَلْ تَسْتَطِيعُ صُنْعَه؟

revealLine.en: It shines, and says: it had a long, shining tail.
revealLine.ar: تَلْمَعُ، وَتَقُول: كَانَ لَهُ ذَيْلٌ طَوِيلٌ لَامِع.

label.en: The last one was purple. Which two make purple?
label.ar: الأَخِيرَةُ كَانَتْ بَنَفْسَجِيَّة. أَيُّ اثْنَيْنِ يَصْنَعَانِ البَنَفْسَجِيّ؟

revealLine.en: It wakes up shivering: it was cold, as cold as ice.
revealLine.ar: تَسْتَيْقِظُ وَهِيَ تَرْتَجِف: كَانَ بَارِدًا، بَارِدًا كَالثَّلْج.
